Q u e s t i o n s
Please confirm your attendance by 15 June 2027. If we have not received your response by this date, we may be unable to reserve your place.
Can I bring a plus one?
Your invitation will indicate whether a plus one has been reserved for you. Please include their name when completing the RSVP form.
Unless specifically mentioned on your invitation, our celebration will be for adults only. We hope this allows everyone to relax and enjoy the evening.
The dress code is elegant garden attire. Soft, natural colours and lightweight formalwear are encouraged. We kindly ask guests to avoid white and ivory.
Please arrive between 3:30 PM and 3:45 PM. The ceremony will begin promptly at 4:00 PM.
Will the wedding take place outdoors?
The ceremony and aperitivo are planned for the gardens, while dinner will take place on the covered terrace. In the event of rain, an indoor arrangement will be available.
Transfer details will be shared with confirmed guests closer to the wedding date. Taxis will also be available at the end of the evening.
Can I take photographs during the ceremony?
We kindly ask that phones and cameras remain put away during the ceremony. Our photographer will capture every moment, and we would love to see your photographs during the reception.
What if I have dietary requirements?
Please include any allergies or dietary requirements in your RSVP. Our catering team will be happy to accommodate them.
Limited parking is available near the venue. We recommend using the arranged transfer or travelling by taxi whenever possible.
